title: Palabra al azar
description: *Palabra al azar* shows a **random Spanish word** and hides its meaning behind a button, so you can guess first and then check.

The words are **everyday Spanish from Spain**. The list comes from what people say in film subtitles, and it drops words that the dictionary marks as old, cultured, rare, or used only in the Americas.
The page stays light: it carries only the word list, and it asks **Wiktionary** for the definition of the one word on screen. The filtering rules are **covered by tests written before the code**.
imageAlt: Headline "A random Spanish word. Do you know it?" above the page showing the word coger, with its definition open: four senses of the transitive verb and links to Wiktionary and the RAE dictionary
